name: Text Pulse
description: A quick health check for any piece of writing. Live counts while you type, readability on the Flesch scale with its grade equivalent, reading and speaking time at a speed you choose, repeated vocabulary, and a spotlight on overlong sentences. Reads pasted text, the current selection, or the article in the tab you are on. Entirely local, no accounts, no uploads.

browser_action.default_title: Text Pulse — Take the vitals of your writing
